t: The Erbauer rechargeable LED worklight provides powerful, high-performance illumination for demanding jobsites. This slim portable light delivers up to 2000 lumens across a wide 100° beam, making it ideal for electricians and plasterers working in dark spaces. Engineered with constant lumen output technology, the worklight maintains consistent brightness without dimming as the battery depletes. A digital indicator shows the exact remaining battery percentage, while the integrated 30W USB-C power bank charges devices on site. This durable IP65-rated light offers up to 16 hours of runtime and features rotating hooks for versatile positioning.
